content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Peoria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Document your work history, education credentials, and specific project roles. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team will review your background to confirm eligibility before you enroll in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led curriculum covers the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world case studies. You'll attend sessions on your schedule—no travel to Peoria required—and receive all materials and lifetime access to recorded sessions.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education, project experience, and training completion. Pay PMI's exam registration fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and document requirements to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A support—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center near you. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or professional contributions. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your competitive edge in your local job market.
